description: Fork of exp197 (val_bpb=1.6806 @ 8K). Replace the per-block double MLP (out_proj + FFN) with a single MultiHeadLut + SparseScatter consuming raw post-SDPA E=384 activations. LUT: nap=6 (64 cells/table), tph=384, n_sparse=32 (scattered into E=384), n_alternatives=1, smooth_mode=False (hard forward / STE backward, per original exp192 spec), CANONICAL_FULL_COVERAGE. LUT cell weights placed in a no-decay AdamW group (per exp191). Soft V2D, untied head, qkv_std=0.005 unchanged. Param budget per block ≈ 786K (n_alt=1).
